groups.name: BI Interest Rate Policy
groups.narrative: Markets are reacting to the upcoming Bank Indonesia interest rate decision amid a sharp decline in the IHSG index.
groups.narrative_zh: 由于雅加达综合指数大幅下跌，市场对印尼央行即将公布的利率决定反应强烈。
groups.R_reason: BI interest rate decisions are binary or quantitative.
groups.U_reason: Monetary policy trajectory depends on inflation and exchange rate data.
groups.H_reason: High impact on financial markets and news coverage.
groups.suggested_question: Will Bank Indonesia increase, decrease, or hold the BI rate at the next policy meeting?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 印尼央行在下一次会议上会加息、降息还是维持利率不变？

groups.name: Indonesian Economic Stability
groups.narrative: The Rupiah is weakening, fuel subsidies are a point of concern, and foreign capital is shifting in the mining sector.
groups.narrative_zh: 印尼盾持续走弱，燃油补贴引发担忧，外资正在矿业领域进行调整。
groups.R_reason: Economic indicators are clear but complex to define as a single binary bet.
groups.S_reason: Government fiscal reports and central bank data.
groups.H_reason: High public interest in fuel prices and inflation.
groups.suggested_question: Will the Indonesian Rupiah exchange rate against USD be above 16,500 by end of Q2 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 2026年第二季度末印尼盾兑美元汇率是否会高于16,500？

groups.name: Prabowo Administration Governance
groups.narrative: Public and legal pressure on the new administration, including protests over taxes and high-level security around the parliament.
groups.narrative_zh: 针对新政府的舆论与法律压力不断，包括针对税收的抗议以及议会周围的高度安全警戒。
groups.R_reason: Protests or specific policy changes are measurable.
groups.S_reason: Official government decrees or parliament session records.
groups.suggested_question: Will major tax reforms be passed by the DPR RI before 2027?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 印尼众议院是否会在2027年前通过主要的税制改革？

groups.name: Gaza Flotilla Incident
groups.narrative: Indonesian citizens have been detained by Israeli forces during a humanitarian mission to Gaza.
groups.narrative_zh: 多名印尼公民在前往加沙的人道主义任务中被以色列军队扣押。
groups.R_reason: Release of citizens is a binary outcome.
groups.T_reason: Diplomatic timelines are uncertain but finite.
groups.U_reason: Diplomatic outcomes depend on complex international negotiations.
groups.H_reason: High political and emotional stakes in Indonesia.
groups.suggested_question: Will the detained Indonesian citizens be released by Israeli forces before June 20, 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 被扣押的印尼公民是否会在2026年6月20日前获释？

groups.name: KPU Digital Voter Reform
groups.name_zh: 印尼大选委员会数字化改革
groups.narrative: The KPU is conducting focus groups on integrating digital voter data with Govtech systems.
groups.narrative_zh: 印尼大选委员会（KPU）正在就数字选民数据与Govtech系统集成进行焦点小组讨论。
groups.R_reason: Implementation of digital systems can be verified.
groups.U_reason: Government technology projects often face delays.
groups.H_reason: Moderate interest from tech and political sectors.
groups.suggested_question: Will the KPU successfully launch the integrated digital voter registration system by year-end 2026?
groups.suggested_question_zh: 印尼大选委员会是否会在2026年底前成功上线整合的数字选民登记系统？
